_pattern_max_partial.source:
@triton.jit
def _pattern_max_partial(X, Partial, COLUMNS: tl.constexpr, CHUNKS: tl.constexpr, BLOCK: tl.constexpr):
    chunk = tl.program_id(0)
    row = tl.program_id(1)
    offsets = chunk * BLOCK + tl.arange(0, BLOCK)
    values = tl.load(X + row * COLUMNS + offsets, offsets < COLUMNS, other=-float('inf')).to(tl.float32)
    maximum = tl.max(values, 0)
    tl.store(Partial + row * CHUNKS + chunk, maximum)

_pattern_split_partial.source:
@triton.jit
def _pattern_split_partial(X, Weight, Partial, ROWS: tl.constexpr, COLUMNS: tl.constexpr, INNER: tl.constexpr, SEGMENT: tl.constexpr, TILE: tl.constexpr, INNER_TILE: tl.constexpr):
    rows = tl.program_id(0) * TILE + tl.arange(0, TILE)
    columns = tl.program_id(1) * TILE + tl.arange(0, TILE)
    part = tl.program_id(2)
    offsets = tl.arange(0, INNER_TILE)
    accumulator = tl.zeros((TILE, TILE), tl.float32)
    for step in range(tl.cdiv(SEGMENT, INNER_TILE)):
        inner = part * SEGMENT + step * INNER_TILE + offsets
        first = tl.load(X + rows[:, None] * INNER + inner[None, :], (rows[:, None] < ROWS) & (inner[None, :] < INNER), other=0)
        second = tl.load(Weight + inner[:, None] * COLUMNS + columns[None, :], (inner[:, None] < INNER) & (columns[None, :] < COLUMNS), other=0)
        accumulator = tl.dot(first, second, accumulator)
    tl.store(Partial + (part * ROWS + rows[:, None]) * COLUMNS + columns[None, :], accumulator, (rows[:, None] < ROWS) & (columns[None, :] < COLUMNS))

_pattern_scan_local.source:
@triton.jit
def _pattern_scan_local(X, LocalValues, LocalIndices, Totals, TotalIndices, AXIS: tl.constexpr, INNER: tl.constexpr, CHUNKS: tl.constexpr, BLOCK: tl.constexpr):
    chunk = tl.program_id(0)
    line = tl.program_id(1)
    positions = chunk * BLOCK + tl.arange(0, BLOCK)
    base = line // INNER * AXIS * INNER + line % INNER
    values = tl.load(X + base + positions * INNER, positions < AXIS, other=float('inf')).to(tl.float32)
    indices = tl.where(positions < AXIS, positions, -1)
    scanned, scanned_indices = tl.associative_scan((values, indices), 0, _pattern_min_pair)
    tl.store(LocalValues + base + positions * INNER, scanned, positions < AXIS)
    tl.store(LocalIndices + base + positions * INNER, scanned_indices, positions < AXIS)
    last_lane = tl.minimum(BLOCK - 1, AXIS - chunk * BLOCK - 1)
    is_last = tl.arange(0, BLOCK) == last_lane
    minimum = tl.sum(tl.where(is_last, scanned, 0), 0)
    last_index = tl.max(tl.where(is_last, scanned_indices, -1), 0)
    tl.store(Totals + line * CHUNKS + chunk, minimum)
    tl.store(TotalIndices + line * CHUNKS + chunk, last_index)

_pattern_scan_carry.source:
@triton.jit
def _pattern_scan_carry(Totals, TotalIndices, Carry, CarryIndices, CHUNKS: tl.constexpr, BLOCK: tl.constexpr):
    line = tl.program_id(0)
    offsets = tl.arange(0, BLOCK)
    values = tl.load(Totals + line * CHUNKS + offsets, offsets < CHUNKS, other=float('inf'))
    indices = tl.load(TotalIndices + line * CHUNKS + offsets, offsets < CHUNKS, other=-1).to(tl.int32)
    scanned, scanned_indices = tl.associative_scan((values, indices), 0, _pattern_min_pair)
    tl.store(Carry + line * CHUNKS + offsets + 1, scanned, offsets + 1 < CHUNKS)
    tl.store(CarryIndices + line * CHUNKS + offsets + 1, scanned_indices, offsets + 1 < CHUNKS)
    tl.store(Carry + line * CHUNKS, float('inf'))
    tl.store(CarryIndices + line * CHUNKS, -1)

_pattern_scan_finish.source:
@triton.jit
def _pattern_scan_finish(LocalValues, LocalIndices, Carry, CarryIndices, Values, Indices, AXIS: tl.constexpr, INNER: tl.constexpr, CHUNKS: tl.constexpr, BLOCK: tl.constexpr):
    chunk = tl.program_id(0)
    line = tl.program_id(1)
    positions = chunk * BLOCK + tl.arange(0, BLOCK)
    base = line // INNER * AXIS * INNER + line % INNER
    local = tl.load(LocalValues + base + positions * INNER, positions < AXIS, other=float('inf'))
    local_index = tl.load(LocalIndices + base + positions * INNER, positions < AXIS, other=-1)
    carry = tl.load(Carry + line * CHUNKS + chunk)
    carry_index = tl.load(CarryIndices + line * CHUNKS + chunk)
    take_carry = (carry < local) | (carry == local) & (carry_index > local_index)
    tl.store(Values + base + positions * INNER, tl.where(take_carry, carry, local), positions < AXIS)
    tl.store(Indices + base + positions * INNER, tl.where(take_carry, carry_index, local_index), positions < AXIS)

_pattern_bias_tile.source:
@triton.jit
def _pattern_bias_tile(X, Weight, Bias, Out, ROWS: tl.constexpr, START: tl.constexpr, GROUP: tl.constexpr, INNER: tl.constexpr, COLUMNS: tl.constexpr, TILE: tl.constexpr, INNER_TILE: tl.constexpr):
    rows = tl.program_id(0) * TILE + tl.arange(0, TILE)
    columns = tl.program_id(1) * TILE + tl.arange(0, TILE)
    offsets = tl.arange(0, INNER_TILE)
    accumulator = tl.zeros((TILE, TILE), tl.float32)
    for step in range(tl.cdiv(INNER, INNER_TILE)):
        inner = step * INNER_TILE + offsets
        first = tl.load(X + (START + rows[:, None]) * INNER + inner[None, :], (rows[:, None] < ROWS) & (inner[None, :] < INNER), other=0)
        second = tl.load(Weight + GROUP * INNER * COLUMNS + inner[:, None] * COLUMNS + columns[None, :], (inner[:, None] < INNER) & (columns[None, :] < COLUMNS), other=0)
        accumulator = tl.dot(first, second, accumulator)
    bias = tl.load(Bias + GROUP * COLUMNS + columns, columns < COLUMNS, other=0).to(tl.float32)
    tl.store(Out + (START + rows[:, None]) * COLUMNS + columns[None, :], accumulator + bias[None, :], (rows[:, None] < ROWS) & (columns[None, :] < COLUMNS))

_floor_divide_int32.source:
@triton.jit
def _floor_divide_int32(first, second):
    numerator = first.to(tl.uint32)
    denominator = second.to(tl.uint32)
    numerator = tl.where(first < 0, 0 - numerator, numerator)
    denominator = tl.where(second < 0, 0 - denominator, denominator)
    quotient = tl.full(first.shape, 0, tl.uint32)
    remainder = tl.full(first.shape, 0, tl.uint32)
    for bit in tl.static_range(31, -1, -1):
        remainder = remainder << 1 | numerator >> bit & 1
        subtract = remainder >= denominator
        remainder = tl.where(subtract, remainder - denominator, remainder)
        quotient = quotient << 1 | subtract.to(tl.uint32)
    negative = (first < 0) != (second < 0)
    signed = tl.where(negative, 0 - quotient, quotient).to(tl.int32)
    return signed - (negative & (remainder != 0)).to(tl.int32)

_gather.source:
@triton.jit
def _gather(X, Index, Out, COLS: tl.constexpr, OUT_COLS: tl.constexpr, SOURCE_BLOCK: tl.constexpr, INDEX_BLOCK: tl.constexpr):
    row = tl.program_id(0)
    source_columns = tl.arange(0, SOURCE_BLOCK)
    output_columns = tl.arange(0, INDEX_BLOCK)
    value = tl.load(X + row * COLS + source_columns, source_columns < COLS, other=0)
    index = tl.load(Index + row * OUT_COLS + output_columns, output_columns < OUT_COLS, other=0).to(tl.int32)
    result = tl.gather(value, index, 0)
    tl.store(Out + row * OUT_COLS + output_columns, result, output_columns < OUT_COLS)

_matmul.source:
@triton.jit
def _matmul(X, Weight, Out, ROWS: tl.constexpr, COLS: tl.constexpr, INNER: tl.constexpr, TILE: tl.constexpr, INNER_TILE: tl.constexpr):
    rows = tl.program_id(0) * TILE + tl.arange(0, TILE)
    columns = tl.program_id(1) * TILE + tl.arange(0, TILE)
    inner = tl.arange(0, INNER_TILE)
    accumulator = tl.zeros((TILE, TILE), tl.float32)
    for step in range(tl.cdiv(INNER, INNER_TILE)):
        positions = step * INNER_TILE + inner
        first = tl.load(X + rows[:, None] * INNER + positions[None, :], (rows[:, None] < ROWS) & (positions[None, :] < INNER), other=0)
        second = tl.load(Weight + positions[:, None] * COLS + columns[None, :], (positions[:, None] < INNER) & (columns[None, :] < COLS), other=0)
        accumulator = tl.dot(first, second, accumulator)
    tl.store(Out + rows[:, None] * COLS + columns[None, :], accumulator, (rows[:, None] < ROWS) & (columns[None, :] < COLS))

_witness_neg4.source:
@triton.jit
def _witness_neg4(X, Out, D0: tl.constexpr, D1: tl.constexpr, D2: tl.constexpr, D3: tl.constexpr, B: tl.constexpr):
    packed = tl.program_id(2)
    i0 = packed // D1
    i1 = packed % D1
    i2 = tl.program_id(1)
    i3 = tl.program_id(0) * B + tl.arange(0, B)
    offset = ((i0 * D1 + i1) * D2 + i2) * D3 + i3
    x = tl.load(X + offset, (i0 < D0) & (i3 < D3), other=0)
    tl.store(Out + offset, -x, (i0 < D0) & (i3 < D3))

_witness_neg3.source:
@triton.jit
def _witness_neg3(Input, Out, D0: tl.constexpr, D1: tl.constexpr, D2: tl.constexpr, STRIDE: tl.constexpr, BLOCK: tl.constexpr):
    first = tl.program_id(2)
    second = tl.program_id(1)
    last = tl.program_id(0) * BLOCK + tl.arange(0, BLOCK)
    offset = (first * D1 + second) * D2 + last
    valid = (first < D0) & (last < D2)
    value = tl.load(Input + offset * STRIDE, valid, other=0)
    tl.store(Out + offset, -value, valid)

_witness_masked_softmax.source:
@triton.jit
def _witness_masked_softmax(X, Mask, Out, R: tl.constexpr, L2: tl.constexpr, XS1: tl.constexpr, XS2: tl.constexpr, XSR: tl.constexpr, MS1: tl.constexpr, MS2: tl.constexpr, MSR: tl.constexpr, OS1: tl.constexpr, OS2: tl.constexpr, OSR: tl.constexpr, B: tl.constexpr):
    line = tl.program_id(0)
    a = line // L2
    b = line % L2
    r = tl.arange(0, B)
    value = tl.load(X + a * XS1 + b * XS2 + r * XSR, r < R, other=0).to(tl.float32)
    keep = tl.load(Mask + a * MS1 + b * MS2 + r * MSR, r < R, other=0)
    masked = tl.where((r < R) & (keep != 0), value, -float('inf'))
    e = tl.exp(masked - tl.max(masked, 0))
    result = e / tl.sum(e, 0)
    tl.store(Out + a * OS1 + b * OS2 + r * OSR, result, r < R)
